documentation.content:
The hourly sync job **fitdata-sync** failed. The dashboard stops getting new data until a run succeeds.

- Executions: https://console.cloud.google.com/run/jobs/details/__REGION__/__JOB__/executions?project=__PROJECT__
- Logs: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="__JOB__"' --project __PROJECT__ --limit 50`

If the logs say the token no longer works, use **Obnovit přístup k datům** on https://__DOMAIN__.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = "__JOB__" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "failed"
